description:
Check on a screenshot set, waiting up to wait_seconds for it to finish. Step 3 of 3.

When it is ready this returns the review link, the headline written for every screen and the three directions. Share the link with the user: they choose a direction and the set opens in the LaunchShots editor (free signup if they are not signed in). If it is still generating, call again — a set usually takes 1–2 minutes.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for a set that is still generating (0–50, default 45).

name: get_screenshot_set
title: Get screenshot set
